mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tenant (id, name, status, status_version, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{name}, #{status}, #{version}, now(), now(), NULL, NULL) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET status = EXCLUDED.status, status_version = EXCLUDED.status_version, updated_at = now(), updated_by = NULL WHERE tenant.status_version < EXCLUDED.status_version AND NOT tenant.deleted
INSERT INTO tenant (id, name, status, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{name}, #{status}, now(), now(), NULL, NULL) ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT name FROM tenant WHERE id = #{tenantId} AND NOT deleted
